subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be split into a heartbeat wake precedence bugfix first, with Telegram DM default isolation handled separately?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path violates explicit session configuration, but changing Telegram DMs away from the documented main-session default can break users relying on shared main-session continuity.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` win for event-triggered wakes and keep Telegram DM defaults governed by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram default isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default as part of this issue, accepting the upgrade and documentation impact for existing users.

options.title: Defer to per-session heartbeat design
options.body: Wait for native per-session heartbeat scheduling work, which may be cleaner long term but leaves the current forced-session contamination path unresolved.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` win for event-triggered wakes and keep Telegram DM defaults governed by `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans heartbeat ownership, routing compatibility, and product defaults, and Peter's history covers the unified heartbeat and routing surfaces.
